title: Reattach an input device to a master
summary: Attach a floating input device back to a master pointer or keyboard. This restores normal behavior where the device controls the main cursor.

steps.explain: Reattach the device to a master using the device ID and the master ID.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the input device to reattach.

placeholders.name: MASTER_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the master pointer or keyboard.

steps.expect: The device is now controlled by the specified master.
